_about: PILOT build data: Swirls ep08 'Can Any Good Thing' uplift. Shot list (trim only, 1.0x, hard cuts) + pencil marks. Spec: SWIRLS_UPLIFT_SPEC.md sections 5-6. Times are frames at 30 fps on the film timeline; voice starts at frame 0. Geometry is normalised 0..1 of the 1080x1920 frame, read off audit/sheet_p8.jpg (10x10 red grid) - the executor must re-measure on the real frame before render (gate G-KEEP).

shots.words: A man insulted Jesus behind His back. Jesus complimented him to his face.
Philip told Nathanael the news: the Messiah - Jesus, of Nazareth.
Nathanael's answer: Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip did not argue - he invited.

shots.status: NEW CLIP of the existing still (8 s)
shots.words: Jesus spoke first: Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile! Nathanael asked:

shots.status: NEW CLIP of the existing still (10 s)
shots.words: Jesus answered: Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee. A moment only heaven had seen - named.
The doubt did not fade. It fell.
Nathanael said: Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.
And Jesus went further: Thou shalt see greater things than these...
Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.

shots.status: existing, borrowed from the Jacob's Ladder film on purpose (page turn in)
shots.words: That is Jacob's ladder - the one Jesus said He is, standing open, permanently.
He is not offended by honest questions. He already sees you, under your fig tree.
